rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or group is becoming increasingly tired or less energetic.

example.english: After running for a while, I was flagging more and more.
example.jyutping: paau2 zo2 jat1 zan6 ngo5 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 gui6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the emphasis is on dwindling physical strength, energy, or effectiveness.

example.english: After playing a game, I was flagging.
example.jyutping: daa2 jyun4 coeng4 bo1 ngo5 mou5 saai3 lik6

rows.note: Use this mainly for an activity, business, or situation that is going into decline rather than for someone simply feeling tired.

example.english: This shop has been flagging in recent years.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 gan6 nin4 zau2 haa6 bo1
